name: Prudentia YouTube Video-on-Demand
description: Prudentia (SIGCOMM '24) YouTube VOD workload. Plays a YouTube video (Big Buck Bunny by default) using the browser's ABR player for the configured duration. Parameter 'video_id': YouTube video ID (v= portion of the URL, default: dQw4w9WgXcQ). Parameter 'watch_seconds': seconds to watch (Prudentia uses 600 s; use 60 for quick tests).
specification: Prudentia YouTube video-on-demand workload (SIGCOMM '24, Table 1). 1. Go to 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=<video_id>&autoplay=1'. 2. Wait briefly for the player to load. 3. Keep the video playing for watch_seconds seconds.

workflow.specification:
Prudentia YouTube video-on-demand workload (SIGCOMM '24, Table 1).
1. Go to 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v= video_id &autoplay=1' (reference video: Big Buck Bunny).
2. Wait briefly for the player page to load and autoplay to start.
3. Keep the video playing for watch_seconds seconds (Prudentia runs 600 s and ignores the first/last 120 s).

name: Prudentia Vimeo Video-on-Demand
description: Prudentia (SIGCOMM '24) Vimeo VOD workload. Opens the Vimeo embed player for a video (Big Buck Bunny by default) with muted autoplay and watches it for the configured duration. Parameter 'video_id': Vimeo video ID (default: 76979871 for Big Buck Bunny). Parameter 'watch_seconds': seconds to watch (Prudentia uses 600 s; use 60 for quick tests).
specification: Prudentia Vimeo video-on-demand workload (SIGCOMM '24, Table 1). 1. Open the Vimeo embed player for video_id with muted autoplay. 2. Wait briefly for playback to start. 3. Keep the video playing for watch_seconds seconds.

workflow.specification:
Prudentia Vimeo video-on-demand workload (SIGCOMM '24, Table 1: BBR, 2 flows, max 14 Mbps, 7 bitrates up to 4K).
1. Open the Vimeo embed player for video video_id (reference video: Big Buck Bunny) with muted autoplay.
2. Wait briefly for the player to load and playback to start.
3. Keep the video playing for watch_seconds seconds (Prudentia runs 600 s).

name: Prudentia Wikipedia Web Browsing
description: Prudentia (SIGCOMM '24) Wikipedia web-browsing workload. Loads a Wikipedia page 10 times with a configurable gap between loads. Parameter 'page_url': Wikipedia URL to load (default: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Internet). Parameter 'gap_seconds': seconds between page loads (Prudentia uses 45 s; use 5 for quick tests).
specification: Prudentia wikipedia.org web-browsing workload (SIGCOMM '24, section 5.2). Load page_url 10 times with gap_seconds seconds between each load.

workflow.specification:
Prudentia wikipedia.org web-browsing workload (SIGCOMM '24, section 5.2; Table 1: BBRv1.0, >5 flows, mostly text with one or two images).
1. Load page_url in the browser.
2. Wait gap_seconds seconds (Prudentia uses 45 s between loads).
3. Repeat the load ten times in total.

name: Prudentia Google News Web Browsing
description: Prudentia (SIGCOMM '24) news.google.com web-browsing workload. Loads a Google News page 10 times with a configurable gap. Parameter 'page_url': Google News URL (default: https://news.google.com). Parameter 'gap_seconds': seconds between page loads (use 5 for quick tests).
specification: Prudentia news.google.com web-browsing workload (SIGCOMM '24, section 5.2). Load page_url 10 times with gap_seconds seconds between each load.

workflow.specification:
Prudentia news.google.com web-browsing workload (SIGCOMM '24, section 5.2; Table 1: BBRv3.0, >20 flows, text accompanied by thumbnail images).
1. Load page_url in the browser.
2. Wait gap_seconds seconds.
3. Repeat the load ten times in total.
